Game.pokeLoungeDesc: Invite friends with a room code to catch and train Pokémon in the same village. Bring your own teams to a three-round championship.
Game.pokeLoungeShareDesc: Catch and train Pokémon with friends, then battle across three tournament rounds. An unofficial Pokémon fan game you can play together in your browser.
Game.introFinalDescription: Create a room and send your friends the invite code. An adventure in the same village becomes your very own Pokémon showdown.
Game.introFanNotice: An unofficial fan game made with love and respect for Pokémon. All related rights belong to their respective owners.
Game.introVideoDescription: From choosing a partner to exploring tall grass and battling in a tournament. See moments from the real game.
Game.introVideoLabel: Actual Poke Lounge gameplay showing partner selection, exploration and a tournament
Game.introDescription: Invite friends with a code. Catch and raise Pokémon in the same village, then bring your own parties to a three-round championship.
Game.introPlayNote: No install or login · Desktop & mobile · Up to 8 players
Game.introHeroAlt: A pixel-art autumn village with a bridge, river, tiled-roof houses and colorful maple trees
Game.introJourneyTitle: One village. A journey to champion.
Game.introJourneyDescription: Gather your friends and pick a partner. Then it is time to explore and battle.
Game.introStep01Description: Create a room and share the invite code. Up to 8 human and AI trainers can join, with AI filling empty spots.
Game.introStep01Alt: Actual lobby screen with friend invites, participating trainers and ready status
Game.introRoomNote: Join a public room, or invite friends to a private room with a code or link.
Game.introStep02Description: Classic mode offers six starters. Random mode gives each trainer their own six slots.
Game.introStep02Alt: Actual game screen for choosing a first partner Pokémon
Game.introDrawTitle: What is in my six slots?
Game.introDrawDescription: Every trainer gets a different set in random mode. Five slots reveal first-stage Pokémon; the last is a mystery question mark.
Game.introMysteryRule: The mystery slot can contain any evolution stage.
Game.introDrawDisclaimer: This is a demo preview. Actual candidates are drawn afresh in each game room. Legendary and Mythical Pokémon are excluded.
Game.introClassicNames: Bulbasaur · Charmander · Squirtle · Chikorita · Cyndaquil · Totodile
Game.introStep03Eyebrow: New friends in the tall grass
Game.introStep03Description: Find Pokémon in tall grass, catch them and help them grow. Choose 90 seconds, 3 minutes or 5 minutes to explore.
Game.introStep03Alt: Actual game screen showing a trainer exploring the village and tall grass
Game.introStep04Description: Battle with the party you raised. Tournament matchups are randomized each round.
Game.introStep04Alt: Actual turn-based battle screen showing two Pokémon and move selection
Game.introBracketLabel: An eight-trainer bracket with quarterfinals, semifinals and a final
Game.introStep05Description: Explore again and keep raising your party each round. Add up the scores from three tournaments to determine the final standings.
Game.introVideoTitle: Get a glimpse of the adventure.
